summary: Iter 165 Academy /kurse rebuild — frontend-only regression. 9 of 10 review scenarios PASS. Only issue: horizontal overflow on /kurse/<slug> detail page at 390px viewport (mobile). All hero/categories/filters/cards/deep-links/progress/PLUS-lock/unknown-slug/sidebar/console-clean scenarios verified across free, standard, and accelerator users.

issues: Horizontal overflow: document.scrollWidth = 533px vs clientWidth = 390px (~143px overflow). Overflowing elements all have width 517px starting at left=16 (course-episode-pending video, course-episode-title, course-episode-bullets, course-episode-list). The two-column layout (video/bullets + episode-list aside) does not collapse to single column below md breakpoint. /kurse index at 390px is fine (no overflow, single column). Only the detail page is affected.

Suggested fix: on CourseDetailPage.js main content grid, use `grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]` (or similar) instead of a fixed 2-col grid; ensure inner children set `min-w-0` to prevent grid blowout.

Filters: courses-count '10 von 10' initial. course-category-executive tile → '4 von 10' + aria-pressed=true + 4 exec cards; click again → '10 von 10'. course-filter-cat-fuehrung → 3 cards, '3 von 10'. course-filter-status-locked → 10 cards (all locked for free). course-filter-status-started → 0 cards + courses-empty visible. course-filter-status-all resets to 10.
courses-hero-start navigates to /kurse/rhetorik-grundlagen?folge=1 (first course with no seen episodes). courses-hero-browse scrolls courses-list into view (top 663→24).

course-start-schwierige-gespraeche → /kurse/schwierige-gespraeche?folge=1. course-detail-page + course-header + course-detail-progress + course-detail-cta ('Folge 1 kostenlos ansehen') + course-episode-pending (video not recorded — acceptable per task) + course-episode-title + course-episode-bullets + course-ask-wlad-btn + course-episode-list + course-back all present.

PLUS course /kurse/ki-first-leadership?folge=2 as standard → course-episode-locked visible with text containing 'PLUS'. As accelerator user → NOT locked (unlocked).

Progress after marking delegation-1 seen: course-progress-delegation bar + course-seen-delegation text '1/4 gesehen'; course-start-delegation label 'Weiter mit Folge 2'; courses-progress hero shows '1 / 72'; course-filter-status-started → 1 card.
Unknown slug /kurse/does-not-exist → course-not-found + 'Zur Bibliothek' link back to /kurse.
Responsive /kurse at 390x844: no horizontal overflow, cards single column (grid-template-columns=358px), hero readable.
/courses/schwierige-gespraeche.jpg static asset returns HTTP 200 (thumbnails available; visually rendered in screenshots).
No console errors on /kurse or detail page (only expected 404 on /kurse/does-not-exist course-load AxiosError, which is the not-found path).
action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on CourseDetailPage: collapse the two-column player/episode-list grid to single column below the lg breakpoint. Currently ~143px of the layout extends past a 390px viewport. Add min-w-0 to inner grid children and use responsive grid-template-columns.
critical_code_review_comments: CourseDetailPage.js grid layout is not mobile-safe. Add responsive breakpoints; enforce min-w-0 on grid children to avoid intrinsic content pushing width beyond viewport.
courses-more-{chat,guide,challenge} are <button> with onClick navigate(). Consider using <Link> for better a11y and native href navigation, though functionally correct.

course-thumb- testid is on the wrapper; the actual child is not directly targeted. That's fine for click-tests but note images are lazy children — thumbnails render OK (verified visually and via static asset probe /courses/*.jpg → 200).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full /kurse Academy rebuild verified functionally. Only remaining item is a mobile CSS overflow on CourseDetailPage (~143px past 390px viewport). Standard user's delegation-1 seen state has been marked in DB via API — expect course-seen-delegation '1/4 gesehen' persisting. Login: POST /api/auth/login {identifier,password} → token in localStorage 'wladbot_token'. Dismiss cookie banner ('Nur notwendige') and support popup ('Nein danke').
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow on /kurse/<slug>: the main content grid on CourseDetailPage retains its multi-column width (~517px per column) at 390px viewport because either (a) the grid uses fixed pixel/fr definitions that don't collapse below md, or (b) inner children lack min-w-0 and their intrinsic content (video 16:9, episode-list ASIDE) forces the grid to overflow. Reproduce: viewport 390x844, navigate /kurse/schwierige-gespraeche?folge=1; document.scrollWidth=533 vs 390. Fix: make the layout `grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]` and add `min-w-0` to grid children.
